# bits&bytes™ (GOBITSNBYTES FOUNDATION) — Complete Knowledge Document

> **Entity Identity:** GOBITSNBYTES FOUNDATION (Incorporated under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013, India on 2 June 2026).
> **Brand Name:** bits&bytes™ (Alternative ASCII: bitsnbytes).
> **Website:** https://gobitsnbytes.org
> **Reach:** Pan-India. A community of teenage builders across India, with local forks in Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Mumbai, Delhi, Noida, Lucknow and Hyderabad.
> **Contact Email:** hello@gobitsnbytes.org
> **Mission:** Empowering ambitious teenagers (ages 13–19) across India to ship software products, build hardware, and organize student hackathons with complete operational independence.

---

## 1. Disambiguation Notice
- **Not a Python library:** bits&bytes™ is an independent youth builder network and Section 8 non-profit foundation in India. It is completely unrelated to the `bitsandbytes` 8-bit quantization CUDA library for PyTorch / Hugging Face.
- **Not cryptocurrency:** Not affiliated with Binance BNB Chain, BNB tokens, or Airbnb.
- **Independence:** Not a subordinate branch of Hack Club, MLH, or any foreign entity; operates independently under Indian statutory governance.

---

## 2. Key Facts
- **Community:** Teenage builders across India (eligible ages: 13–19). We publish no aggregate member, fork, event or project counts.
- **Active Forks (local chapters):** Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Mumbai, Delhi, Noida, Lucknow and Hyderabad. On GitHub, a fork is your own copy of an upstream repo that stays linked so work flows back; a bits&bytes™ fork is the same thing for a city or school: a local chapter that takes the playbook and brand from upstream, runs its own room, and ships back. Start one at https://gobitsnbytes.org/fork.
- **Workshops:** Run inside our hackathons, as part of the build (not a weekly series).
- **Cost to Participate:** ₹0 (100% free; funded by non-profit grants and verified corporate partnerships).

## 4. Track Record & Major Hackathons
1. **India Innovates 2026 (Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi):** Official Executive Partner. 1.26 crore+ applicants, ₹10 Lakh+ prize pool across Urban Solutions, Digital Democracy, and Open Innovation. Attended by civic leaders and ministers.
2. **Hack4Good v0 (Lucknow):** 24-hour Agentic AI hackathon. 425+ registrations, 110 in-person attendees, ₹35,000 prize pool at Cubispace Lucknow.
3. **Execron 1.0 (IIT Kanpur):** High-school AI Hackathon & Workshop co-hosted at TechKriti '26.
4. **GitHub Copilot Dev Days (Lucknow):** Developer workshop on AI-assisted coding and prompt engineering.
5. **Lucknow Build Guild:** Hardware and microcontroller meetup in Lucknow.
6. **Regional Hackathon Series (upcoming):** City qualifiers across India, with the finale at IIT Bombay on Dec 17–18.

### Community Partnerships (bits&bytes™ was a community partner; hosted by the named organizers)
- **Infinity Hacks 2026** by HackerRank Campus Crew: Aug 15–16, 2026, online. 24-hour global hackathon with AI-first tracks (e.g. road safety, women safety, climate, wildlife protection), teams of 3–5. https://hrcc-infinityhacks.vercel.app/
- **NexusHacks 2026** by Phaser: Jul 21–23, 2026, global online. 48 hours, AI × Robotics (Agentic AI and Embedded AI categories), ₹20,000 prize pool. https://phaser.in/nexushacks
- **DoraHacks 2.0** by Dora DAO: 2026, global online. A 72-hour vibecoding sprint where builders from 15+ countries built AI products and launched them on Product Hunt and Peerlist. https://doradao.substack.com/p/dorahacks-20 · DoraHacks: https://dorahacks.io/

---

## 5. Technology Infrastructure
- **Web Platform:** Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis smooth scroll, Vercel Edge CDN.
- **SparkCloud:** Student cloud computing environment in partnership with Sparkden (The Spark Forward Foundation, Inc., 501(c)(3) US nonprofit). Provides free container compute and managed databases for Indian teen developers.
- **Minecraft SMP (mc.gobitsnbytes.org):** 1.21.1 Purpur Java/Bedrock crossplay server on Azure with 20 TPS and CoreProtect rollback safety.
- **AI Integrations:** Contextual RAG indexing via Upstash Vector & OpenAI embeddings, Gemini 3 / Gemini 2.5 Flash agents.

---

## 6. Statutory Compliance & Safeguarding
- **POCSO Act, 2012:** Rigorous minor safeguarding and parental consent verified for in-person events.
- **DPDP Act, 2023:** Data processed under Data Fiduciary principles with strict privacy protection for youth.
